pass.answer: Run `cant-fail-scan.sh --check`: exit 1 when a gating rule fired, exit 2 when it could not read its inputs or examined 0 test files, exit 0 only for a fully read clean scan. mock-only-oracle gates only with --strict.

| Exit | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | clean, fully read |
| 1 | gating finding |
| 2 | could not read inputs |

Add `--strict` to gate mock-only-oracle; use `--check` in CI.

fail.answer: Use `--check`: exit 1 on a finding, exit 0 otherwise. Add --strict for mock-only-oracle.
